tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search BangkokVacay business listings by keyword and/or category. Returns sanitized public listings (name, description, address, phone, hours, photos, booking links). Only quality listings are returned: publicly active, with a real name and a real description (50+ chars).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the BangkokVacay directory's top-level business categories.

labels.name: list_categories
labels.description: Read-only. List the BangkokVacay directory's top-level categories with listing counts.

labels.name: list_filters
labels.description: Read-only. Values usable in search_listings: areas/neighborhoods, price tiers, amenities and tags, each with listing counts, plus notes on how each is derived.

labels.name: search_tours
labels.description: Read-only. Live search of bookable tours and activities in Bangkok, Thailand from Viator's partner API. Returns title, live starting ('from') price and currency, rating, review count, duration, free-cancellation flag, image and a booking_url. Optional start_date/end_date return only products Viator

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_listings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search BangkokVacay business listings by keyword and/or category. Returns sanitized public listings (name, description, address, phone, hours, photos, booking links). Only quality listings are returned: publicly active, with a real name and a real description (50+ chars)." → after: "Search BangkokVacay's curated directory of Bangkok, Thailand businesses (hotels, restaurants, bars, activities, attractions, shops and services). Read-only. Filters: keyword, category, area/neighborhood, price tier, amenities (e.g. pool, spa, river_view, rooftop, michelin), tag, and distance from a "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
